early-source.question: Can retained source and compact projection make grounded documentation useful without a working application build?
early-source.baselineAndTreatment: Released/native/manual-oracle fixture questions; source admission and projection were separate treatments.
early-source.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Use existing September qualification records; do not equate oracle delivery with automatic product savings.

architecture-contracts.question: Which architecture and OpenAPI contract relations are actually captured and source-linked?
architecture-contracts.baselineAndTreatment: Versioned Java/Kotlin source/compiler capture and bounded violation/control matrices.
architecture-contracts.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Repeat only for a changed capture/contract mechanism; preserve unresolved and unexecuted gates.

reader-and-content.question: Can a reader follow the process, alternatives, effects and failures without machine metadata overload?
reader-and-content.baselineAndTreatment: Source-bound narratives, compact readers, Markdown, tables, diagrams and native navigation.
reader-and-content.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Require source-to-reader meaning and actual visual evidence; successful rendering alone is insufficient.

weather-runtime.question: Do supported Weather replay, export and launcher flows preserve evidence and reader behavior?
weather-runtime.baselineAndTreatment: Frozen Weather inputs, installed/experimental runtime boundaries, replay/export and visual checks.
weather-runtime.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Reuse unchanged successful runtime/export evidence; do not generalize a single-service acceptance to the system.

source-provenance.question: Can an author discover and obtain exact retained source with stable native identity?
source-provenance.baselineAndTreatment: Declaration/file discovery, whole-file retention, source union, immutable Work and citation binding.
source-provenance.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: A new source/binding delta needs exact-byte and identity negatives; provenance consistency is not semantic completeness.

authoring-mechanics.question: Does the supported authoring/finalization route avoid needless copying while preserving editable original prose?
authoring-mechanics.baselineAndTreatment: Original fragments, body-free binding, saved context, checked pages, source display and finalization helpers.
authoring-mechanics.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Measure the complete author/review/repair path, not just initial input or one successful API call.

comparisons.question: Does the complete documentation workflow improve comparable cost and reader quality?
comparisons.baselineAndTreatment: Frozen paired Direct/Clew authoring, independent terminal critics, separate cost reconciliation.
comparisons.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Name an untested material delta before another costly trial; preserve frozen failures and same-service comparators.

single-author-weather.question: Can one Luna Max author explain all mandatory Forecasts meanings before READY?
single-author-weather.baselineAndTreatment: N1-N10 vary one delivery/guidance/review/finalization mechanism; same public source16 and reader question.
single-author-weather.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: N5 is Forecasts-only; validate all actual Weather services and interactions. Verified: Forecasts, Places, Dashboard; requested fourth unspecified. No unchanged prompt-only repeat.

lexical-review.question: Can compact native structural/lexical review expose omissions without inventing execution semantics?
lexical-review.baselineAndTreatment: Kotlin statement/condition review and Java saved lexical adapter; exact source spans and explicit prefixes.
lexical-review.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Mechanical row conservation must be followed by independent semantic assessment; never prune nested events for cost.

retired-transfer.question: Do the same mechanisms transfer to a held-out public Java service?
retired-transfer.baselineAndTreatment: Retired RealWorld source capture, Direct and Clew v1/v2/v3; frozen terminal outcomes.
retired-transfer.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Historical only after the October30 scope correction. Do not restore deleted raw artifacts or rerun this corpus.

research-design.question: Is the proposed study comparable, bounded and worth another author run?
research-design.baselineAndTreatment: Protocol review, relevance/meaning-loss diagnosis, delivery/phase accounting, duplicate-hypothesis checks.
research-design.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: A protocol or counterfactual is not an executed experiment; resolve the observed blocker first.

support-and-build.question: Can diagnosis, packaging and local development avoid repeated setup and preserve evidence?
support-and-build.baselineAndTreatment: Diagnostics, cache/build cleanup, CI throughput and release mechanics supporting documentation studies.
support-and-build.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Operational checks do not establish reader quality or cost advantage; routine implementation needs no research approval layer.

evaluator-artifacts.question: Which retained evaluation artifacts belong to already counted trials?
evaluator-artifacts.baselineAndTreatment: Blind packages, seals and source/reader indexes; no independent author treatment.
evaluator-artifacts.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Do not count evaluator packages or copies as new successful experiments.

restricted.question: Which generic lessons can be retained without disclosing a private case?
restricted.baselineAndTreatment: Only anonymized public-safe aggregate conclusions; private records are not opened for this ledger.
restricted.nextConditionAndNonrepeatRule: Keep local private evidence and identity mapping private; no public service, endpoint, organization or path details.

metricDefinitions.reasoning: subset of output, never added twice
metricDefinitions.historicalLogicalTokens: input_tokens + output_tokens including cached input; do not compare directly with net
metricDefinitions.unavailable: Absent metric/identity/timing is unavailable, not zero
metricDefinitions.criticCost: Separate from production author, retained as additional evaluation cost
metricDefinitions.currentCeiling: <=1.5 times comparable same-service Direct, conditional on complete truthful clear documentation; time is not a gate
